answer: Sybil resistance works when every identity must pay an unrecoverable cost before it can attest. A joining agent submits a signed hardware proof plus a stake, and peers check that proof against independent on-ledger history, the way growth rings date a willow. Cloned agents betray themselves through shared timing fingerprints, so the registry quarantines the whole island of duplicates at once, while honest timber keeps compounding reputation and lower fees.
